class.name: JRPGActorAmountCommand
class.brief_description: The base of the actor commands that change a value by an amount.
class.description: An actor command ([JRPGActorCommand]) that changes a value by [member amount], or by variable [member amount_variable_id]'s value when [member amount_is_variable] (an integer; a float is cut to one; text is 0), added on [constant OPERATION_INCREASE] and taken away on [constant OPERATION_DECREASE]. Authority: server.

members.member: The amount, when it is not read from a variable.
The amount is variable [member amount_variable_id]'s value.
The variable the amount is read from.
Whether the amount is added or taken away.
